summary: The page maintains a clear dark-theme visual structure, but exhibits typography kerning artifacts splitting words across components, alongside low-contrast text within the thought log container.

issues.title: Unintended word splitting
issues.description: Font rendering or tracking issues insert extraneous spaces within words across multiple text elements.
issues.evidence: Visible spaces breaking words in 'finis hes', 'auto no mo us', 'Monda y', and 'c an retune'.
issues.suggestion: Correct font-tracking, letter-spacing properties, and string sanitization.

issues.title: Low contrast status item
issues.description: Pending log text fails readability expectations against the dark card surface.
issues.evidence: Text reading 'Waiting on the tuning sliders before applying anything' is difficult to discern against the background.
issues.suggestion: Increase opacity or lighten the muted text token.
